title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap **More info** on an item and paste the request there, and she'll dig in.

items.headline_md: US-brokered **Russia–Ukraine** talks open in Abu Dhabi
items.summary_md: Kushner and Witkoff are mediating the first direct talks in months; the sides remain far apart on territory and security guarantees.

items.headline_md: Update: Trump says the Iran war is "militarily effectively over"
items.summary_md: Speaking after meeting Qatar's prime minister, Trump said the US is "just keeping it the status quo"; Iran's president says Tehran is open to talks.

items.headline_md: Rep. **Massie** forces a House vote on impeaching **Hegseth**
items.summary_md: The Kentucky Republican filed articles over the Iran war; a vote is expected this week and needs a few GOP votes to pass.

items.headline_md: **12** migrants found dead off Crete; about **105** rescued
items.summary_md: Greek authorities reported the deaths across three separate rescue operations south of the island.

items.headline_md: Flooding swamps tens of thousands of tents in **Gaza**
items.summary_md: The Board of Peace warned of an escalating humanitarian emergency after two days of seasonal flooding.

items.headline_md: **Boeing** to cut about **5%** of its commercial airplane workforce
items.summary_md: Stephanie Pope told staff slower 737 MAX ramps leave the unit overstaffed; cuts mix attrition and layoffs, with notices starting in December.

items.headline_md: Update: **Nvidia** shares fall **4.2%** to an April low over the Huang probe
items.summary_md: Investors are questioning the CEO's future after the board opened an inquiry into whether a foreign intelligence effort targeted him.

items.headline_md: **Mitsui Chemicals** to buy chip-materials maker **JSR** for about **$11.6B**
items.summary_md: It's the biggest deal in Japan's chemicals sector, and Mitsui Chemicals' shares fell 8.5% on the news.

items.headline_md: **Honda** to invest **$3B** in a new Ohio hybrid plant
items.summary_md: The facility is due to start production in 2029 and build up to 240,000 vehicles a year.

items.headline_md: **Warhammer Survivors** launches on iOS and Android
items.summary_md: Auroch Digital and Poncle's Vampire Survivors-style bullet heaven has 40 characters, 75+ weapons, and a 10% launch discount.

items.headline_md: This week's new mobile games include **Football Manager 27 Touch** on Apple Arcade
items.summary_md: Other Nov 9–15 launches include Lil' Guardsman, Booster Pack Heroes, and Thrifty Business.

items.headline_md: **Delta Force** opens its "Aurora" season with a Phantom Blade Zero collab
items.summary_md: Garena's Nov 10 update is live now.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: no public repo or release from the r/decomps Wii U lifter author turned up in web searches today, and Reddit's feeds blocked direct reads.

items.headline_md: **Astral Chain PC** recomp posts a new build
items.summary_md: The native Windows x86-64 static recomp of the Switch game (Vulkan, your own dump required) shipped a Nov 10 build and is playable through the story.

items.headline_md: **ps2-native-recomp** reaches v0.0.5
items.summary_md: An early-stage PS2-to-native recompiler pushed a new release on Nov 9.

items.headline_md: **Virtua Fighter Recomp v1.7.0** plus VF2 and VF3 recomp updates
items.summary_md: All three Sega arcade recomps updated on Nov 10, alongside SMM2 Recomp v0.7.11 and Shaolin Monks Recomp v0.5.0.

items.headline_md: **PCSX2 2.9.167** prerelease lands with a Vulkan graphics change
items.summary_md: It's a dev build, not stable; RPCS3, shadPS4, KytyPS5, and DuckStation also kept daily builds flowing.

items.headline_md: Weekend Nov 6–8: **Godzilla Minus Zero** No. 1 at **$30.6M**
items.summary_md: The Cat in the Hat was second at $20.0M, then Drummer Boy $9.4M and Ramayana $8.9M; A24's You Can See Everything passed $79.4M.

items.headline_md: **Godzilla Minus Zero** earns an **A** CinemaScore and **90%** on Rotten Tomatoes
items.summary_md: Audiences rate it 96% on the Popcornmeter.

items.headline_md: This weekend: **How to Rob a Bank** ($8–15M) and **Victorian Psycho** ($2.5–5M) join Ebenezer
items.summary_md: Box Office Theory pins Ebenezer near $22M, with Hunger Games still tracking $100M+ for Nov 20.

items.headline_md: **Skydance** targets **$6B+** in cuts after the Warner Bros. merger
items.summary_md: Savings include $2.2B in overhead and facilities, $1.4B in tech, and $1B in marketing over three years.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** releases **Claude Fable 5.2** and **Mythos 5.2**
items.summary_md: Output is 30% faster than 5.1 and pricing drops to $8 / $40 per million tokens; Mythos is limited to vetted orgs.

items.headline_md: **Meta** launches **Muse Ember**, a cheap model for agent busywork
items.summary_md: At $0.10 / $0.50 per million tokens, Meta says it matches Claude Haiku 5.5 at about a third of the cost.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** buys **$3.4B** of gas turbines and still plans its IPO
items.summary_md: The Claude maker is joining the natural-gas rush for data center power despite market jitters.

items.headline_md: Google adds **Google Maps Platform** app-building to **AI Studio**
items.summary_md: Developers can prompt their way to map apps with free sandbox access and no credit card.

items.headline_md: Apple ships **iOS 27.2.1** with security fixes
items.summary_md: Patches cover Messages, AirPlay, and more; iOS 26.7.3 and watchOS 27.2.1 also went out.

items.headline_md: **Wyndham** exposed customer data through an app security lapse
items.summary_md: TechCrunch reports the hotel giant's app left guest data open.

items.headline_md: Ad tech split: **AppLovin** revenue up **55%** while rivals struggle
items.summary_md: Digiday's Q3 breakdown also has Unity up 32%, led by its Vector AI ad platform.

items.headline_md: Futures mixed pre-CPI: **Dow +0.5%**, S&P +0.2%, Nasdaq 100 −0.1%
items.summary_md: Quoted at 3:17 AM ET (1:17 AM AZ); October CPI is due at 8:30 AM ET (6:30 AM AZ).
The S&P 500 rose 2.35% to 7,549.94, its best day since April, and the Nasdaq gained 2.74%.

items.headline_md: Oil keeps sliding: **WTI $84.48** (−2.2%)
items.summary_md: Quoted 08:55 GMT (1:55 AM AZ); Brent was near $91 after Monday's 5.9% drop.
Gold quoted 12:04 UTC (5:04 AM AZ); traders now price a December Fed hike.

items.headline_md: **Phoenix**: sunny, **83°** / **58°**, 0% precip
items.summary_md: Sunny today with light winds and a clear night; no active alerts.

items.headline_md: **Show Low**: sunny, **60°** / **31°**, 0% precip
items.summary_md: Sunny with northeast wind up to 9 mph, mostly clear tonight; no active alerts.

items.headline_md: **Snowflake**: fog early, then sunny, **61°** / **31°**, 0% precip
items.summary_md: Patchy fog before 8 AM, then sunny; fog may return after 2 AM tonight. No active alerts.

items.headline_md: All the takeaways about **GTA VI** from Take-Two's earnings call
items.summary_md: GamesBeat lays out what Zelnick said about "unprecedented" pre-orders and the Nov 19 launch, a useful read on where game spending is headed this holiday.
